usedFor: An app ID posted in a Slack channel starts store ranking tracking in Applyra.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Track App” in Applyra
bestTemplate.why: A teammate posts a store ID and tracking starts without opening Applyra.

watchOut: “Track App” needs a store ID, country and language, so agree one message format for the channel.
